key_insight: Adding an AI teammate does more than change team output—it can also reshape how the human teammates talk to each other, altering communication patterns during decision-making. The study suggests that AI team members may unintentionally create social and cognitive side effects in human-human interaction.
problem_solved: This paper addresses the gap in understanding how conversational AI teammates affect the communication dynamics between human team members in small-group, high-stakes decisions.
method: Ran a randomized controlled study with small teams completing a high-stakes moral-dilemma decision task.
Compared teams with an AI teammate against all-human teams.
Analyzed team interaction using Group Communication Analysis (GCA), team surveys, and lexical analysis of discourse.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this highlights that evaluating AI teammates should go beyond accuracy or task success and include social effects on human collaboration. It is especially relevant when deploying AI in team-based, high-stakes, or decision-critical settings.
visual_elements: Side-by-side team setup diagram: human-human-AI vs all-human teams
Flowchart of the experimental design and decision task
Communication network or speech pattern visualization showing interaction changes
Bar chart comparing survey and discourse metrics across conditions
paper_title: The Social Cost of an AI Teammate: How an Artificial Teammate Reshapes Human-Human Communication in Small-Team Decision-Making
paper_authors: Nia Nixon, Jaeyoon Choi, Pedro Martins De Bastos, Mohammad Amin Samadi, Luise Mehner
